capabilities.name: Range vector selection
capabilities.description: Selecting a window of samples ending at each evaluation point, per PromQL's range vector selector syntax.

capabilities.name: Line filter expression
capabilities.description: Filtering log lines by a literal or regex match, per LogQL's line filter syntax.

capabilities.name: Span attribute filter
capabilities.description: Filtering spans by an attribute comparison, per TraceQL's attribute selector syntax.

capabilities.name: Label matcher expression
capabilities.description: Matching a resource/series label by equality or regex. Every head parses its own label matcher syntax, but the equality/regex semantics are shared, so this capability is explicitly universal rather than attached to one head.
